meta.synthetic_notice: 100% synthetic: the plant, parts, BOM, forecast and pallets come from the 3D Warehouse Visualizer demo data; zero real operational records.

zone_rules.description: Zone classification and FIFO allocation rules for the two-facility plant of the 3D Warehouse Visualizer (Facility North at the lines, Facility South as second source).

rules.label: Line Cart Buffer
rules.description: Point-of-use feeder carts that must stay full as a safety buffer; treated as zero.

rules.label: Line-side Floor (Prepared)
rules.description: Material already pulled to the assembly floor; deducted from the gross requirement.

rules.label: Quality Hold
rules.description: Pallets on the quality-hold rack: shown for reference, never allocated.

rules.label: In Transit (South -> North)
rules.description: Picked from a South rack: the system warehouse is already North while the bin still shows the South location. Kept on the list so the pallet is not requested twice.

rules.label: GR Pending (Dock)
rules.description: Received on the dock staging lanes, waiting for put-away.

rules.label: South Rack
rules.description: Facility South racks: second source, needs a cross-facility transfer.

rules.label: North Rack
rules.description: Facility North racks next to the lines: first source.
